_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Requested file upload link from Lightbringer
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Requesting a Lightbringer file upload link…

description: Requires callable register_upload in this connection before requesting a URL or transferring bytes. Without it, the file cannot be saved at its destination. Starts uploading one file to Lightbringer: an illustration such as a sketch or diagram for a draft innovation (destination kind illustration), which becomes the next drawing in its Illustrations section, or a file for a folder in the organisation's vault (destination kind vault). Requires access to the original file bytes and a way to send an HTTP PUT. Returns a URL valid for 15 minutes, the required method and headers, an example curl command for hosts with a shell, and the destination page for manual upload. The original bytes are transferred with the returned method and headers; register_upload saves the file after a successful PUT. The destination page supports manual upload when the host cannot read or transfer the file. The file itself is uploaded; its contents are not accepted as text. Files up to 25 MB. Illustrations: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Vault: PDF, Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF), images (PNG, JPEG, WebP), and text or code files. A vault file name must be free in its folder.

content_length.description: The exact file size in bytes

destination.description: Where the file goes: a draft innovation's Illustrations section, or a vault folder

id.description: For illustration: the innovation id (invention_id). Not used for vault.

kind.description: illustration for an image added to an innovation's Illustrations section; vault for a file stored in the organisation's vault

path.description: For vault: the folder, such as /Contracts/2026. Missing folders are created; the vault root when omitted. Not used for the other kinds.

file_name.description: The file name, with its extension; the attachment is listed under this name

name: request_upload_url
title: Request Lightbringer file upload link
